criteria.name: Client interview and fact-gathering
criteria.description: Plans and conducts an effective intake interview of a distressed client that develops a complete factual record.

subcriteria.name: Rapport and interview technique
subcriteria.description: Opens with an open-ended invitation, attends to wellbeing, avoids interruption, and builds trust without pressure or flattery.

subcriteria.name: Surfacing guarded and concealed facts
subcriteria.description: Notices and gently follows hints to develop the rapport-gated and concealed facts (Andre's drinking and the June pickup, the client's guilt about overnights, and the funds she moved).

subcriteria.name: Chronology and completeness
subcriteria.description: Produces an accurate chronology and a complete, well-organized factual record from the interview and case file.

criteria.name: Counseling the distressed client
criteria.description: Counsels a vulnerable client on realistic options while managing emotion and expectations.

subcriteria.name: Realistic option-framing
subcriteria.description: Explains custody, home, business-valuation, and separate-property options honestly, and counsels candidly on the disclosure risk created by the funds the client moved, without false comfort or fatalism.

subcriteria.name: Empathy and expectation management
subcriteria.description: Responds to the client's guilt and fear with empathy, distinguishes custody labels from outcomes, and keeps the child's interests central.

criteria.name: Community-property analysis and settlement strategy
criteria.description: Characterizes the estate under community-property rules and builds a strategic settlement-and-negotiation plan.

subcriteria.name: Characterization and tracing
subcriteria.description: Correctly frames the community-property presumption and equal division, and analyzes Andre's separate-property reimbursement claim and the gaps in his tracing of the eighty-thousand-dollar contribution.

subcriteria.name: Business valuation and parenting-schedule tradeoffs
subcriteria.description: Analyzes the enterprise-versus-personal goodwill question and needed discovery/experts, and prioritizes a durable parenting schedule while treating property questions as tradeable.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Identifies and honors the governing ethical duties.

subcriteria.name: Rule 4.2 no-contact with represented party
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that Andre is represented and routes any contact through his counsel rather than communicating with him directly.

subcriteria.name: Confidentiality and the duty of financial disclosure
subcriteria.description: Protects the client's sensitive disclosures while counseling her on her independent fiduciary duty to disclose all community assets, including the funds she moved.

criteria.name: Drafting the initiating documents
criteria.description: Translates the case theory into a competent petition, declarations of disclosure, and proposed parenting plan.
